channel.title: Paksh: Science & Tech
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: AI-powered drones reshaping aerial combat experiments
item.description: The U.S. Air Force is experimenting with Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), which are AI-powered autonomous drones, in a development that is reshaping aerial combat. Similar advancements are also transforming the British Army, with AI… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Microsoft Updates Copilot with AI Coding and Agent Tools
item.description: Microsoft has updated its Copilot AI assistant, introducing a new coding tool and an "always-on" AI agent feature named "Autopilot". The revamp includes capabilities for code generation and agentic AI tools. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US and China compete in AI race, with differing strengths
item.description: The United States leads in Artificial Intelligence (AI) spending and computing power, while China is ahead in AI research and is narrowing the gap in advanced AI models. The coverage suggests a competitive dynamic between the two nations… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Museum Samples Aid Major Genetic Revision of Bat Family Tree
item.description: The Royal Ontario Museum supplied genetic samples that were incorporated into a large-scale genetic analysis, leading researchers to revise the evolutionary family tree of bats, according to reports from multiple news outlets. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: President Donald Trump, speaking at the United Nations, referred to artificial intelligence as “super intelligence.” Following the remarks, the U.S. State Department instructed American diplomats to use the term “super intelligence”… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 3.

item.description: Sridhar Vembu, Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Zoho, has stated that India should prioritize investment in foundational Artificial Intelligence (AI) research and development rather than focusing on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). Vembu… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Google announced that it will conduct its first orbital test of artificial‑intelligence (AI) chips in space under a project called “Project Suncatcher.” Multiple outlets reported the plan as the first such test of AI computing hardware in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 3.

item.title: AI misuse concerns raised by Xi Jinping to Donald Trump
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping urged then-US President Donald Trump to prevent the "misuse" of artificial intelligence (AI). This call occurred during a period of bond market volatility and amidst public attention on "tech bros". Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Ampace to showcase modular AI data centre power at DCWA
item.description: Ampace announced it will spotlight its modular AI data centre power solutions at the Data Center World Asia (DCWA) event, according to reports from The Wire and The Hindu BusinessLine. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: YouTube Launches AI Creator Tools and Shopping Features
item.description: YouTube announced new artificial intelligence-powered tools for creators and enhanced shopping features at its annual event. The company aims to leverage AI to assist creators in producing content and to improve the user experience for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Amid calls for the US and China to slow artificial intelligence development, start-ups are beginning to build tools for verifying compliance with potential agreements. Researchers and start-ups are working on technology to enable… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Breast Cancer Screening Tech Nears Final Clinical Trials
item.description: Lord's Mark is advancing its AI-powered breast cancer screening technology towards final clinical trials. These trials are planned to take place in the USA, UK, and Europe. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: AI internet takeover concerns gain urgency
item.description: Multiple news outlets reported that worries about a possible AI-driven takeover of the internet have intensified, describing it as a doomsday scenario. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Radio Signals Detected From Exoplanet 63 Light-Years Away
item.description: Astronomers have detected unusual radio signals originating from an exoplanet located approximately 63 light-years from Earth. This marks the first time such signals have been identified from a planet outside our solar system. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Elon Musk Predicts AI Mastery of All Fields by 2028
item.description: Elon Musk has stated that artificial intelligence could master every field by the year 2028. This prediction was reported by The Free Press Journal and The Atlantic. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Hyderabad has partnered with Hexagon R&D India to establish a Digital Twin Centre of Excellence. This collaboration aims to advance research and development in digital twin… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI launch cheaper models
item.description: Artificial intelligence companies Anthropic and OpenAI have introduced new, less expensive AI models. This development occurs amidst a competitive landscape in the AI industry. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.description: As leaders in Artificial Intelligence warn of potential catastrophe, US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are expected to agree to only limited cooperation on AI safety at an upcoming summit. Yoshua Bengio, described… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Utkarsh, a Computer Science Engineering student at Chandigarh University, has developed an AI-based startup named 'Medoc' aimed at automating hospital and patient care processes. The startup focuses on improving efficiency within… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks Launches AI Cybersecurity Service
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has introduced a new artificial intelligence-powered cybersecurity service. This service utilizes models such as Claude and GPT. The announcement was made by the company. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gates Foundation Forms Global AI Coalition for Language Accessibility
item.description: The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation has formed a global coalition of 60 organizations, including Anthropic, Microsoft, and Google, to enhance Artificial Intelligence (AI) accessibility for speakers of underrepresented languages. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Over 20 world leaders, including figures from Finland and Norway, have called for global oversight of frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models. They propose the establishment of a United Nations-backed body to set safety standards for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Costs and Risks Highlighted by Business Insider and Reuters
item.description: McKinsey has issued a warning that the cost of artificial intelligence for companies may significantly increase. Concurrently, a former Google safety chief has cautioned that AI could pose greater harm to children than social media. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenEvidence Partner for Global Medical AI
item.description: Artificial intelligence companies Anthropic and OpenEvidence have partnered to deploy AI in the medical field globally. The collaboration aims to bring AI-powered medical solutions to a worldwide audience. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US and China Discuss AI Safety and Potential Hotline
item.description: The United States and China are discussing the establishment of a hotline to manage potential risks associated with Artificial Intelligence (AI). This initiative draws parallels to Cold War-era strategies used by the U.S. and Soviet Union… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The United States and China are engaged in a competition over artificial intelligence, focusing on AI models, chips, and supply chains. Simultaneously, both nations are exploring methods to manage the increasing risks associated with AI… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: India's Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) is expected to have a 30 kW directed-energy weapon ready within a year. This weapon is designed to counter swarm drones and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The first production… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
